groups.decision: OEM retrospective supports a common pre-2025 family, EU corroboration only.
groups.exceptions: US manual and catalog differences; fork/shock settings, tolerances and lubrication remain exact-year.

groups.decision: Start a new research root at 2025.
groups.exceptions: Do not inherit 2022–2024 chassis or engine service details; CRF450R shared chassis language is not shared engine identity.

groups.decision: Treat 2025 running gear as a changed assembly set.
groups.exceptions: 2022–2024 engine continuity not established by this source; 2026 extension needs source comparison.

groups.decision: 2024–2025 cannot share an unqualified suspension baseline or internal rebuild kit.
groups.exceptions: Linkage, spring, fork shim and damping changes; engine repair equivalence not inferred.

groups.decision: Prioritize direct manual/catalog comparison for reuse; new ECU lock is explicit.
groups.exceptions: OEM feature omission does not prove identical suspension internals, settings or engine tolerances.

groups.decision: Use new 2026 research root and the acquired exact US manual.
groups.exceptions: Regional source establishes boundary, not US service numbers; aftermarket cable-clutch conversions require installed-build override.

groups.decision: Split 2022 from 2023 in suspension and chassis research.
groups.exceptions: FC250 new-engine claim does not assign FC250 internals to FC450; Canada source requires US catalog confirmation.
Existing M16 manual vs M14 catalog linkage discrepancy stays unresolved; new-bolt announcement cannot supply torque.

groups.decision: Separate 2022–2023 standard models from 2024 new-generation research.

Regional source requires US reconciliation; no blanket extension to MC250F or 2026.

groups.decision: Separate pre-2024 engine and front-brake procedures.
groups.exceptions: KX450SR and KX450X are not included automatically.

groups.decision: Start separate 2025 top-end, chassis and controls reviews.

2023 YZ450F excluded. Confirm exact SKU/instructions before fitment answer; not a whole chassis family.
2023 YZ250F excluded. No 2026 extension from product dropdown alone; supplier-specific interface only.

groups.decision: Component maker names 2024–2026 kit application; useful single installation-document acquisition target.
groups.exceptions: Require actual SKU and maker installation data. No inferred piston-to-cylinder clearance, ring gap, fuel equivalence or OEM service interval.

recall_exceptions.applicability: VIN-specific; model/year alone identifies potential scope
recall_exceptions.action: For affected VINs follow official stop-use and authorized-dealer inspection/replacement remedy; ordinary retorque is not proof of repair.

unknowns: No all-50 complete generation matrix is claimed.
Engine, chassis, fork, shock, electronics and individual joint applicability must be independent.

2022–2023 GasGas US catalog reconciliation remains pending.
KX250 2022 versus 2023/2024 engine changes need exact OEM acquisition.
CRF450R 2022 versus 2023/2024 engine changes need exact comparison.
Missing manufacturer or year entries remain UNKNOWN, not carry-over.

reuse_policy.allowed: One source acquisition/review plan for a component family, followed by exact-year comparison.
required_before_service_inheritance: Same assembly or explicitly documented supersession including mating parts
Manual edition and joint/procedure comparison including lubricant, sequence and replacement rules
Separate clearance, wear-limit and adjuster baseline verification
not_evidence_of_equivalence: Shared aftermarket exhaust or footpeg fitment
